name: TruePeopleSearch
notes: Search for your record on the removal page, check the confirmation box, then click the link in the email they send you.

name: Spokeo
notes: Paste your profile URL + an email into the opt-out form, solve the CAPTCHA, then click the verification link in the email. Removal within ~72 hours.

name: Whitepages
notes: Suppression request flow; may finish with an automated phone-verification call to a number you provide.

name: Nuwber
notes: Find your listing, copy its URL, paste it into the removal form. Processed within 24-72 hours.

name: Radaris
notes: Paste your profile URL into the privacy-control form; verification code arrives by email or phone.

name: BeenVerified
notes: The opt-out page IS the search: enter name + state, pick your record, then confirm via the email they send.

name: MyLife
notes: Email your profile URL to removalrequests@mylife.com, or call (888) 704-1900 (press 2) and ask to be removed.

name: Acxiom
notes: US consumer opt-out portal; choose deletion + opt-out of sale. Processed ~2 weeks after you click their confirmation email.

name: LexisNexis
notes: Information Suppression Request portal; requires identity verification and sometimes documentation (e.g. ID, proof of address).

name: Epsilon
notes: Data Subject Request form; choose 'Delete my personal information'. They mark records Do-Not-Share rather than hard-deleting.

name: Oracle (Data Cloud / BlueKai / Datalogix)
notes: Oracle shut down its advertising data business in 2024, so this may be unnecessary — email a deletion request covering Datalogix, BlueKai, Grapeshot, and Moat to be safe.

name: Local Test Fixture
notes: Local HTML form for testing the harness without touching any real site. Run: python3 optout.py run --broker test
